title: Digital modes
blurb: The big idea before the cards.

lines.caption: A digital mode sends information as coded data. Packet radio, Wi-Fi and FT8 all do.
lines.say: A digital mode sends information as coded data. Packet radio, Wi-Fi and F T 8 all do.
lines.label: digital modes

lines.caption: Each packet carries a check number. When one arrives damaged, the receiver asks for it again.
lines.label: ask again

lines.caption: APRS sends positions, short messages and weather, and shows every station on a live map.
lines.say: A P R S sends positions, short messages and weather, and shows every station on a live map.
lines.label: APRS

lines.caption: FT8 and the other WSJT-X modes pull signals out from below the noise.
lines.say: F T 8 and the other W S J T X modes pull signals out from below the noise.
lines.label: weak signals

lines.caption: DMR lets two conversations take turns on one repeater channel.
lines.say: D M R lets two conversations take turns on one repeater channel.
lines.label: DMR

lines.caption: And a mesh network turns everyday Wi-Fi gear into a ham data network.
lines.label: mesh network
